system.description:
Usage held book; Weight 4 lbs.

Every Concordance looks unfinished. References continue into empty margins, new indexing tabs appear between pages and passages written in one hand acquire cross-references written in another overnight.

You gain a +2-status bonus to Religion and Linguistics checks specifically involving sacred texts, doctrine, liturgy or the comparison of religious writings.

A character with Recite from the Text asl gains Perfect Reference:

Perfect Reference:

Activate Free (0 AP)

Frequency 1/day

Requirements You possess Recite from the Text

You use Recite from the Text as a Free (0 AP) action instead of its normal action cost. All other requirements remain unchanged.

An Archivist may use the Concordance as their Prayer Book.

On the sheet: +2 status is offered on Religion and Linguistics about sacred texts; Use (with Recite from the Text) makes the next Recite a Free action (1/day). An Archivist may carry it as their Prayer Book — name it so on the Archivist's Prayer Book ability.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
